title: Multiplication in the binary extension field
statement: Let $[?m\ell[0m$ be a positive integer, and let $m,x,y\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$, where $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. Suppose the monic polynomial $X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$ is irreducible over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The residue class of the polynomial encoded by the modular product of $x$ and $y$ equals the product of the residue classes of the polynomials encoded by $x$ and $y$ in the quotient by this modulus.
hypotheses_covered: The modulus coefficients are a vector $m\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$
